summary: Resumed from Phase 3 (previously scoped but not started) and landed Phases 3 and 4 of the nine-phase beta-priority repair plan, fully verified and committed as two separate green-phase commits. Phase 3 is the actual calculus repair the whole task exists to deliver: intExpandBranches.go's match target was swapped from intStepBranch to intStepBranchPrio (beta-priority world-creation scheduling), which required generalizing 11 intStepBranch_* lemmas (the linear/branch preserves family, some_exists_fuel, branchingResult_length, and the low-level some_exists helper) to accept the shared IStepShape predicate introduced in Phase 2, and re-pointing every call site inside the four intExpandBranches.go.induct blocks spanning ~2300 lines of Scheme.lean. CslibTests/BetaSplitRefutation.lean's goRaw recreation was updated to match, and every #guard_msgs assertion whose expected value changed was reconciled across four test files -- the persistence-violation defect the task exists to fix is confirmed gone (some (2, 1, 2) became none) and the frame-adequacy gap for phiRef1/phiRef3 closed ((true, false) became (true, true)). Critically, CslibTests/TableauConformance.lean needed zero changes: all 20 conformance rows, including the complexity-9 divergence witness, hold at their pre-change verdicts, confirming the repair is verdict-preserving as the research report predicted. Phase 4 promoted phiRef4 to a second regression-guard assertion and rewrote the file's module narrative to distinguish the pre-repair defect record (preserved as history, explaining why the repair exists) from the post-repair status. Phase 5 (the freeze lemma) was investigated in depth -- confirmed the underlying claim is true (persistence propagation is proven blind to loop-back edges by direct inspection) but requires a genuinely new global invariant threaded through the whole induction, not a quick local lemma -- and this analysis was recorded in the plan as a Scope-Correction-style note rather than attempted under remaining budget pressure. No sorries, no vacuous placeholders, and no silent scope reduction anywhere in this dispatch.
